hook: RPF ASI pulls man from gap under moving train at Secunderabad
hook_b: RPF ASI pulls man from gap under moving train at Secunderabad
tldr: RPF ASI D Naresh pulled a passenger out of the platform gap after he slipped boarding the moving Godavari Express on Nov 14.

beats.what: The passenger lost his balance trying to board Train No. 12728 and fell into the gap between platform and train.
beats.why: The ASI rushed to the spot and pulled him onto the platform, averting a potentially fatal accident.
beats.care: Boarding a moving train is one of the riskiest things on a platform; it nearly cost a life here.

effects.label: Clip goes viral as safety warning
